description: AthleteProfile field registry ([CTO-QAE-006] §2). Audit metadata for the frozen contract in Domain/Profile/model.ts: per-field sources (evidence keys — NEVER question ids), normalization rule, type, required status, default behavior, confidence behavior, and downstream consumers. Downstream engines read AthleteProfile fields only; this registry is documentation and proof input, not an engine surface.
sourceConvention: sources[] are normalized evidence keys emitted by the question engine (Domain/Evidence). The question-id → evidence-key mapping lives in Contracts/content/question-bank.qae.json; downstream engines never see it.

fields.normalizationRule: constant ATHLETE_PROFILE_SCHEMA_VERSION — structural, not derived from evidence
fields.confidenceBehavior: n/a

fields.normalizationRule: complete iff dataQuality.missingEvidence is empty — incomplete profiles are never consumed for a plan
fields.confidenceBehavior: n/a — completeness is binary, mirrored numerically in dataQuality.confidenceCenti

fields.normalizationRule: integer years, range-validated at normalization; null = unknown = BLOCKING (U1) — never defaults to adult (legacy 'age 0 = adult' is dead)
fields.confidenceBehavior: declared value — no confidence discount; unknown blocks instead of degrading

fields.normalizationRule: declared option verbatim
fields.default: null (mandatory — listed in missingEvidence when absent)
fields.confidenceBehavior: declared value — taken at face value

fields.normalizationRule: cm×10 → mm, integer-canonical (no floats past the boundary)
fields.confidenceBehavior: measured self-report — treated as measured

fields.normalizationRule: kg×1000 → grams, integer-canonical
fields.confidenceBehavior: measured self-report — treated as measured

fields.normalizationRule: kg×1000 → grams when collected; forced null for minors; non-integer input never enters the profile
fields.default: null — meaning is carried by body.weightTargetStatus, never assumed
fields.confidenceBehavior: declared aspiration — pacing derives from effectiveGoal when absent

fields.normalizationRule: L-QST-7 contract fix: presence is a STATUS, never an assumption — notCollected is the current production reality (provider question dead on the impossible answers.primaryGoal path); minors → notApplicableMinor
fields.confidenceBehavior: n/a — status field

fields.normalizationRule: characterized GOAL_FROM_DISPLAY mapping (fat_loss→cut, muscle_gain/strength→bulk, recomp/general_health/get_fitter→maintain)
fields.confidenceBehavior: declared choice

fields.normalizationRule: declared option verbatim
fields.confidenceBehavior: declared choice

fields.normalizationRule: primaryGoal with minors folded to maintain (characterized live policy; SafetyPolicy re-enforces at CRITICAL) — the ONE goal downstream engines read
fields.default: null while primaryGoal or age unknown
fields.confidenceBehavior: derived — deterministic fold, no confidence discount

fields.normalizationRule: true iff 13 ≤ age < 18; unknown age blocks instead of restricting
fields.confidenceBehavior: derived from declared age

fields.normalizationRule: planning classification (separate from the four-axis band); returning recognized before banding
fields.confidenceBehavior: inferred — engines treat as approximate and prefer the four-axis band

fields.normalizationRule: four-axis classification, integer-canonical (EXPERIENCE-MODEL.md); never a single collapsed level
fields.default: all axes at conservative floor when evidence absent
fields.confidenceBehavior: inferred bands — currentWorkCapacity.conservative marks reduced trust after layoff

fields.normalizationRule: returning iff long layoff ∧ real history (characterized); neverTrained iff trainedBefore=never
fields.confidenceBehavior: inferred — drives conservative ramp, never punishes

fields.normalizationRule: declared bucket verbatim (question skipped for never-trained users)
fields.confidenceBehavior: reported history — low confidence until observed logs exist

fields.normalizationRule: integer days 1–7, range-validated at normalization
fields.confidenceBehavior: declared availability — a constraint, not a promise; AdaptationEngine reconciles with observed

fields.normalizationRule: integer minutes, range-validated at normalization
fields.confidenceBehavior: declared availability — same treatment as availableDaysPerWeek

fields.normalizationRule: declared option verbatim
fields.confidenceBehavior: declared fact

fields.normalizationRule: capability derivation — full gym ⇒ ALL capabilities (U3: never machines-only); home from inventory facts
fields.confidenceBehavior: derived capabilities — additive only, absence of evidence never removes bodyweight

fields.type: {overhead, hinge, squatDepth, impact, standing}: string | null each
fields.normalizationRule: declared tolerance buckets verbatim from injury follow-ups — evidence for exercise filtering, never diagnosis
fields.default: null per movement — unasked (no injury path) means no restriction evidence
fields.confidenceBehavior: reported tolerance — SafetyPolicy treats null as unknown, not as cleared

fields.normalizationRule: declared buckets verbatim + integer tenureMonths from the consistency-history axis
fields.confidenceBehavior: reported history — low confidence, superseded by observed logs post-launch

fields.normalizationRule: declared option verbatim — a preference signal, never a capability restriction (U3)
fields.confidenceBehavior: declared preference

fields.normalizationRule: sorted multi-select area tags (select.min 1 enforced upstream when the question is asked)
fields.confidenceBehavior: reported evidence, never diagnosis

fields.normalizationRule: sorted multi-select area tags
fields.confidenceBehavior: reported evidence

fields.normalizationRule: sorted multi-select movement tags
fields.confidenceBehavior: reported evidence

fields.normalizationRule: user-described severity category on the approved 0–10 scale — reported, never diagnosed
fields.confidenceBehavior: reported severity; ≥6 raises the highPain safety flag

fields.normalizationRule: sorted union of reported areas + reported problem movements — tags for metadata filtering only
fields.confidenceBehavior: reported evidence — filtering is conservative, tags never expire silently

fields.normalizationRule: screen answers verbatim; highPain iff painLevel≥6 (characterized threshold)
fields.confidenceBehavior: reported evidence — any flag is honored, never argued down

fields.normalizationRule: true iff any safety flag or pregnant/postpartum — gates SafetyPolicy, never silently cleared
fields.confidenceBehavior: derived gate — one-way (evidence can raise it; only explicit clearance lowers it)

fields.normalizationRule: reported status; male ⇒ notApplicable; unasked ⇒ unknown (never assumed none)
fields.confidenceBehavior: reported status — unknown is honest, not a silent none

fields.normalizationRule: declared bucket verbatim — the questionnaire yields buckets, never invented numbers
fields.confidenceBehavior: low when reported, none when absent

fields.normalizationRule: structurally present; populated from OBSERVED device data post-launch only — never derived from a bucket
fields.confidenceBehavior: none until observed data exists

fields.normalizationRule: low iff a bucket was reported, none otherwise; medium/high reserved for observed data
fields.confidenceBehavior: is itself the confidence carrier for the steps baseline

fields.normalizationRule: declared bucket verbatim
fields.confidenceBehavior: reported estimate — approximate by nature

fields.normalizationRule: declared bucket verbatim
fields.confidenceBehavior: reported estimate

fields.normalizationRule: declared bucket verbatim
fields.confidenceBehavior: reported estimate

fields.normalizationRule: Ramadan seam: host-provided only, never inferred from calendar or locale ([CTO-QAE-005] §10)
fields.confidenceBehavior: n/a until host provides

fields.normalizationRule: declared style verbatim with confidence low; none when unasked
fields.confidenceBehavior: reported self-assessment — always low, never treated as measured

fields.normalizationRule: structurally present now; populated by DataQuality from real logs post-launch — reported and observed are carried side by side, conflicts recorded not reconciled
fields.confidenceBehavior: none until real logs exist; observed outranks reported once present

fields.normalizationRule: mandatory evidence keys absent from facts; non-empty ⇒ profile incomplete ⇒ no plan
fields.confidenceBehavior: is itself the completeness signal

fields.normalizationRule: unresolved bank conflicts + profile-level cross-checks (e.g. painEvidenceWithoutInjuryReport); recorded, never silently reconciled
fields.confidenceBehavior: each contradiction lowers trust in its fields for consumers; data is kept, not dropped

fields.normalizationRule: answered-mandatory share ×10000, integer-canonical (centi-percent)
fields.confidenceBehavior: aggregate completeness score — never a substitute for per-field confidence
